visualizations.title: Heart Disease Output Prediction by Age
visualizations.description: Shows historical data (blue), test actual (green X), test predicted (red circles), and forecast (purple triangles) against age.

visualizations.title: Residual Analysis
visualizations.description: Residual plot with LOWESS fit and residual distribution with KDE overlay.

visualizations.title: Feature Importance by Correlation
visualizations.description: Horizontal bar chart of feature correlations with output.

insights: Model achieved 76.1% accuracy with F1-score of 78.4%. Residuals show random distribution with no clear patterns. Age, heart rate, and ST depression are most predictive features.
data.summary: Linear Regression model demonstrates reliable performance with aligned forecasts and random residuals. Key features identified through correlation analysis.
data.task_answer: The Linear Regression model successfully forecasts heart disease output with 76.1% accuracy. Visualizations confirm predictions align with historical patterns and residuals show random distribution, indicating reliable model performance.
